summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) announcing the grant of 7,025,385 restricted share units (RSUs) to 649 employees under its 2020 Share Incentive Plan. The RSUs have a nil purchase price, with the closing price on the prior business day at HK$37.56 per share. Vesting schedules range from 12 to 48 months with various tranches. No directors, CEO, or substantial shareholders are grantees. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation; no M&A, tender, restructuring, or other event-driven category applies.
